Let us add that uniqueness can be proved for both the Fibonacci and the factorial number systems (and of course for binary and our decimal one as well). The proof is easy but technical – it relies on a general principle: Let us have a system where we can express 1 and in which it holds that the largest number we can express using
digits is 1 less than the smallest number we can express using

digits. In such a system, both completeness (every number can be expressed) and uniqueness then hold. You can try to think this statement through for all the examined systems (binary, Fibonacci, and factorial); the already proved exercises can be a good help :)
